Investment in Presence — Thoughtful, Transparent Fees

I aim for clarity about cost so you can decide from a calm place. Below are the standard session options and several tailored pathways. If affordability is a barrier, I list alternatives and a limited sliding scale.

Intake Snapshot

An initial intake clarifies fit and goals. That meeting is 60 minutes and includes a brief intake questionnaire and safety assessment. I will discuss modality—{{MODALITIES}}—and collaborative expectations.

Therapeutic Pathways

Different rhythms for different needs. Below are three common ways clients tend to engage; we’ll choose what feels right together.

  • Clarity Series — 6 sessions: Focused, short-term work to address a specific issue or transition.
  • Exploratory Work — 12 sessions: Deeper inquiry into patterns, relationship dynamics, or trauma-processing in a paced way.
  • Sustained Support — Ongoing: Weekly sessions for complex or chronic concerns and long-term growth.

Daily Practices I Recommend

Small, consistent habits move therapeutic work into daily life. These are practical and evidence-informed without replacing therapy.

  • Brief morning grounding (3–5 min)
  • Check-ins after triggering interactions
  • Compassionate journaling once or twice a week

Fees — Transparent Options

Session lengths are listed below. If you use insurance, I will provide a superbill. I do not bill insurance directly in most cases; check the note below.

  • Initial Intake (60 min)$185
  • Individual Session (50 min)$150
  • Extended Session (80 min)$220
  • Couples (60–75 min)$185–$230

Packages & pre-paid blocks can be arranged for ongoing work; ask for current bundle rates. I offer a small number of reduced-fee slots; please inquire by email.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Policies, Confidentiality & Boundaries

All sessions are confidential to the fullest extent permitted by law. I maintain professional records and follow legal and ethical regulations about privacy. Emergencies: I do not provide crisis services. If you are in crisis or danger, contact local emergency services or the nearest crisis line. Therapy is collaborative and non-prescriptive; clinical outcomes depend on many factors including engagement outside sessions.

Ready to Talk Through Options?

If you have questions about which pathway fits your situation, I offer a brief 15-minute consult to clarify fit and logistics.

Answers People Ask Before They Start

A short set of practical answers about how I work and what to expect in the first few sessions.

{{THERAPIST_NAME}} • {{LICENSE}}
{{CITY}}, {{STATE}}

Practical Questions

1) How do I know if we’re a good fit?
We begin with a 50–60 minute intake to explore goals, prior care, safety, and expectations. Fit is mutual; if it seems we’re not the best match I will discuss referrals. Clinical fit includes modality ({{MODALITIES}}) and shared values about pace and focus.
2) Can I use insurance?
I provide superbills for out-of-network reimbursement in many plans. I do not typically bill insurance directly. If you have questions about documentation, we can address them during intake.
3) What happens if I need to cancel?
I ask for 48 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or missed sessions may incur a fee, except in genuine emergencies. We will review the cancellation policy before beginning ongoing work.
4) Are our conversations private?
Yes—confidentiality is foundational. Exceptions include imminent risk of harm to self/others, suspected abuse of a minor or dependent adult, or a court order. I will discuss limits to confidentiality during intake and answer any questions you have.
5) How do sessions typically flow?
Sessions are collaborative: check-in, review of what emerged since we last met, focused work for the agreed-upon goal, and a brief plan for between-session practices. I integrate practical tools and relational reflection rather than homework that feels burdensome.
6) Do you work with couples or families?
I see couples for relationship-focused work and occasionally work with family members when relevant. We discuss goals, roles, and confidentiality up front. Complex family systems sometimes require referral to a specialist.
Ask a Question / Schedule

Care Notes & Boundaries

If you are in crisis or having thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call local emergency services or the nearest crisis line. Therapy supports are not immediate crisis response. I maintain secure clinical records and follow professional ethical standards about privacy and reporting obligations.

Short Practices Between Sessions

Small, sustainable practices that people often find helpful:

  • Two-minute grounding breath when reactive
  • One-line reflection in the evening about what shifted
  • Brief self-compassion phrases in moments of self-judgment

Book a Time — Begin with a Brief Consult

I offer a short 15-minute consultation to see if we’re a good fit, followed by an intake session if you choose to proceed. Use the scheduling link below or email to ask questions.

Before You Book

  • Have your availability ready for the next 2–3 weeks.
  • Bring a list of current medications and providers if coordination is needed.
  • Note any urgent safety concerns — if present, contact emergency services instead of booking.
{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

What to Expect in Your First Sessions

15-min Consult
A brief conversation to answer logistics and decide on next steps.
Intake (60 min)
We review history, safety, and start to map goals and early tasks.
Ongoing Sessions
Typically 50 minutes; we establish cadence and brief between-session practices.

Rates & Payment

Intake (60 min): $185
Standard (50 min): $150

I accept card and bank transfer. Superbill available. Reduced-fee spots by request based on need.

Preparing for Your Session

A little orientation helps the first session go smoothly. Consider these micro-practices:

  • Take five minutes to notice and name any feelings before logging on.
  • Write one question or area to focus on — the session can center there.
  • Have tissues and water nearby; create a quiet space when possible.

Policies & Safety

I maintain confidentiality in line with professional ethical codes. Exceptions include imminent risk of harm to self/others, suspected abuse, and court orders. I do not provide emergency services; if you are in crisis call emergency services or a crisis hotline.

Cancellation policy: Please provide at least 48 hours notice for cancellations to avoid a fee. Details will be reviewed in the intake paperwork.

Contact & Quick Connect

If scheduling online is not possible, email {{EMAIL}} or call {{PHONE}} with your preferred days and times. I will respond within 48 business hours.
